subject: Winter sprint: OKR remedials and comms — draft plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Winter sprint: OKR remedials and comms — draft plan

Team —

As promised, attached is the first pass at a concise remediation and comms plan for the items that flagged low evidence or had regressions in the end-of-quarter scoring. High level:

- Scope: 6 objective/KR lines where the score delta >= 0.4 vs last quarter or where we have obvious evidence gaps.
- Proposed remedy types: evidence consolidation, partial-score adjustments with annotated rationale, and targeted operational fixes to close regressions.
- Comm plan: internal leadership note + a one-page QBR slide per affected OKR + optional external-facing summary for customers/stakeholders where the change materially affects commitments.

Asks (please):
1) Laura — take the evidence table and mark any items you believe need the full evidence packet (column E). If you think a score change is warranted, put the suggested score and a single-line rationale.
2) Vivek — I recommend we escalate two items to exec review (listed in the memo). Can you confirm yes/no and whether you want these added to the QBR talking points?
3) Monica — can you draft the external-facing paragraph for Acme (if we decide to share)? If we do, we should keep it short and transparent.

Deadline: please update the attached CSV and the comments in the memo by EOD Wednesday (Dec 22). I plan to fold changes into the QBR slides and circulate the final consolidated memo by Dec 30.

Attachments: okr_remedials_memo_v3.pdf (summary, 2 pages), okr_evidence_table.csv (workbook), slides_qbr_draft.pptx (workspace).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

--

Kimberly —

Thanks for pulling this together. I made a few inline edits and flagged three rows in the evidence table: rows 4, 7, and 12. Quick notes below and a couple of suggested score adjustments.

- Row 4 (Platform Latency OKR): evidence is thin — need the latency heatmap for the last 3 months. Suggest holding score at 0.6 until we have the heatmap.
- Row 7 (Developer Onboarding): I agree with a partial downgrade to 0.7; we missed two delivery milestones tied to the SDK docs. Rationale: missed milestone + survey delta -8 pts.
- Row 12 (Dedicated bookings): looks like an accounting timing issue — recommend keeping score and clarifying in the memo.

I'll upload the annotated CSV by lunchtime. On escalation: I think only the Platform Latency OKR rises to exec level.

Laura
VP, Product Operations

Thanks — good concise set. A couple of decisions from my side:

1) Escalations: Confirming we should escalate the Platform Latency OKR to exec level. Monica, please prepare a 1-slide root-cause + mitigation plan for the QBR. We will reserve 6 minutes in the QBR drill for this.
2) Scoring: Approve Laura's suggested partial downgrade for Developer Onboarding to 0.7. Please add the specific survey lines and milestone IDs into the evidence table.
3) External comms: I prefer we keep external comms limited for now — only share the external-facing paragraph with Acme if they request a clarification. Kimberly, Monica, please only produce the paragraph as 'prep-ready' — don't send yet.

Action items:
- Monica: 1-slide root-cause + proposed mitigations (due Dec 28).
- Laura: Completed evidence table with annotated links (due Dec 22) — thanks for doing this.
- Kimberly: Consolidate and produce final memo + QBR slides (target Dec 30).
